features.name: 21. Multi-Volume Spanning (Multi-Disc Archives)
features.description: Source trees larger than one disc split across volumes, with volume markers and latest-volume-only manifest reads

features.name: 22. Partial/Failed-Write Detection and Recovery
features.description: SUSPECT session marking and interrupted-burn recovery keep the archive readable when a burn fails partway

features.name: 23. Linear/Batched Disc I/O and Redundant-Read Elimination
features.description: Batched read_paths(), one shared manifest load per command, session-ordered replay for restore and verify, and full-copy versus sequential read modes

features.name: 24. Archive Browser and Selective Restore
features.description: ls and browse subcommands list archive contents from disc or ISO manifests and restore an interactively selected set

features.name: 26. Rescue-Key Recovery for Encrypted Archives
features.description: A rescue key derived at init recovers an encrypted archive when the passphrase or keyfile is lost

features.name: 27. Automatic Staging-Space Chunking (Local Temp Storage Limits)
features.description: Staging splits work across multiple passes when the local temp area cannot hold one session's data

features.name: 28. Latest-Volume-Only Correctness for Multi-Volume Discs
features.description: Manifest reads, encryption-mode detection, and sync baselines resolve against the current volume's marker instead of a fixed session number

features.name: 29. Streaming Encryption and I/O for Files Above the AEAD Single-Call Limit
features.description: Large files are encrypted and restored in streaming chunks so no file is bounded by an AEAD single-call size limit

features.name: 30. Single-File Splitting Across Physical Volumes (True Media-Size Agnosticism)
features.description: A single file larger than one disc is split into parts across volumes and reassembled on restore, verified against GB-scale fixtures

features.name: 31. Unhandled Burn Failure Modes (Data-Safety Hardening)
features.description: Disc-full detection on init and append, prior-session re-verification, wrong-disc refusal, mid-write disconnect diagnosis, and a --slow post-burn verify level

features.name: 32. Simplified Technical English (STE) Prose Rewrite
features.description: Every docstring and comment in oddarchiver/ is rewritten in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English; Python source is complete and Markdown docs are pending

features.name: 33. Full Media Support: CD, DVD, BD, and M-DISC
features.description: CD is refused rather than supported because no tested toolchain keeps a CD-R appendable; DVD and bd-dl/bdxl presets are covered by ISOBackend simulation only, while M-DISC BD-R SL is hardware-verified
